text:
A heater supplies 80J of energy to a block of metal. The temperature of the block rises by 20°C.
What happens to the block of metal when its temperature falls by 10°C?
A
Its internal energy decreases by 40J.
B
Its internal energy decreases by 160J.
C
Its internal energy increases by 40J.
D
Its internal energy increases by 160J.
